brief:
**BLUF:** In the core area, McDowell County WV authorities executed a search warrant in Premier leading to multiple drug and firearm charges against a local man, while a Bluefield WV woman was arraigned on attempted murder and related charges in Mercer County court. Tazewell VA recently dedicated a statue honoring native son and Baseball Hall of Famer Billy Wagner on Main Street. In the broader region, a community meeting addressed a proposed industrial energy project in Buchanan County VA.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/20/search-warrant-executed-leads-arrest-premier/)[[2]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/20/bluefield-woman-arraigned-attempted-murder-case/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core (Tazewell County VA and immediate neighbors):** No new arrests, charges, or major court outcomes reported in Tazewell County or Bluefield VA in the last 24 hours.

**Region (nearest first):**  
- Premier, McDowell County WV: On Monday, October 19 at approximately 7:25 p.m., Mario Kearse was arrested after a search warrant at his residence recovered illegal drugs and weapons. He faces charges including possession with intent to deliver a Schedule II controlled substance (fentanyl), possession with intent to deliver a Schedule II controlled substance (crack cocaine), two counts of prohibited person in possession of a firearm, maintaining a dwelling for the sale of controlled substances, and felony conspiracy. The McDowell County Sheriff’s Office, West Virginia State Police Welch Detachment, and Southern Regional Drug and Violent Crime Task Force conducted the operation; the investigation is ongoing.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/20/search-warrant-executed-leads-arrest-premier/)[[3]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/local_news/search-warrant-executed-in-mcdowell-leads-to-drugs-firearm-seizure/article_af930bd2-517b-40e5-87f2-53cd984796fb.html)  
- Bluefield, Mercer County WV: Hallie Graham was arraigned in Mercer County magistrate court on charges of one count of attempt to commit felony, one count of malicious and unlawful assault, and three counts of wanton endangerment. Bond was set at $500,000 cash-only; she was transported to Southern Regional Jail.[[2]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/20/bluefield-woman-arraigned-attempted-murder-case/)

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

NWS alerts: None active. No flooding, winter weather, wildfire/burn bans, power outages, water notices, or major interstate/road closures reported in the core or region.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core:** Nothing new reported.  
**Region:** Buchanan County VA: A community meeting was scheduled for Tuesday night (October 20) to address a proposed industrial energy project.[[4]](https://allevents.in/tazewell/from-tazewell-to-cooperstown-billy-wagner-park-dedication-and-statue-unveiling/200030774182930)

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core:** Tazewell, Tazewell County VA: The Town of Tazewell dedicated Billy Wagner Park and unveiled a statue honoring the Tazewell native, MLB All-Star, and Baseball Hall of Famer on Main Street (ceremony around October 17). Wagner attended and spoke.[[5]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/18/tazewell-unveils-main-street-statue-honoring-hall-fame-closer-billy-wagner/)[[6]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/billy-wagner-statue-unveiling-ceremony-set-for-saturday-october-17/)  
Bluefield VA: The City of Bluefield welcomed prosecutors from Mongolia (noted in recent coverage; details center on judicial exchanges).[[7]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/20/tazewell-dedicates-billy-wagner-statue/)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported.
